# OCI_MIRROR

A pull-through cache on the operator's machine, as a cluster node reaches it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `ociMirror`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.ociMirror`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
